body.heading: Where in the world is Mongolia?
paragraphs: Mongolia is a country in Eastern Asia, which is part of Asia.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Mongolia is Ulaanbaatar.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Mongolia is Mongolian.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Mongolia is the Mongolian tugrik.

body.heading: How big is Mongolia?
paragraphs: Mongolia covers about 1,564,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about twice the size of Türkiye.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: At the Flaming Cliffs, dinosaur eggs and fossils were found in glowing red rock. Nearby, families ride camels among the singing sand dunes of Khongoryn Els.
Each July, Naadam celebrates Mongolia's 'three games' — wrestling, horse racing and archery — and families can stay in a round ger tent on the endless green steppe.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Mongolia on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
